misconceptions.differentiated-for-v: Differentiated dv instead of integrating it.
misconceptions.dropped-1-over-a: Forgot the 1/a that integrating g(ax) brings out.
misconceptions.forgot-to-divide: Didn't divide out the reappearing integral.
misconceptions.loop-confusion: Thought repeated parts never ends here.
misconceptions.loop-sign: Got the sign of the reappearing integral wrong.
misconceptions.loop-vanishes: Expected the integral to disappear after two rounds.
misconceptions.parts-sign: Used uv + ∫v du instead of uv − ∫v du.
misconceptions.polynomial-habit: Made the polynomial u out of habit, but ln x has no easy antiderivative.
misconceptions.power-rule-on-exp: Used the power rule on an exponential.
misconceptions.rounds-too-few: Undercounted the rounds: each round lowers the power by one.
misconceptions.rounds-too-many: Overcounted the rounds: it ends when the power reaches zero.
misconceptions.stopped-early: Stopped before the integral was finished.
misconceptions.swapped-trig: Swapped sin and cos in the result.
misconceptions.trig-sign: Got the sign of the trig integral wrong.
misconceptions.u-gets-harder: Picked the u whose derivative doesn't get simpler, so the new integral is harder.
misconceptions.whole-product-as-u: Took the whole product as u, which leaves an even messier integral.

outcome: Choose u so the integral gets simpler, know when repeated parts ends, and handle the loop.
